semantics.population: A048 iter900; one evaluation seed per case, first episode only
semantics.windows: preregistered [T-1,T); only clipped_order and clipped times use t>=0.5s; all other statistics/controls retain original windows; no relabeling original
semantics.units: time s; height m; angular velocity body rad/s; foot velocity world m/s; forces world N
semantics.support: contact_time>0 is contact indicator, NOT proof of load bearing
semantics.slip: stance foot horizontal speed threshold, NOT proof of frictional slipping
semantics.controls: same-time survivors, NOT terrain/phase matched; repeated windows not independent
semantics.statistics: group summaries median of per-env window values; air stats pooled landing events; no causal or score estimate
